noCreator.title: No profile found for this wallet.

list.empty: No passports minted from this wallet yet.

mints.unlimited: Monthly mint limit: unlimited (P/M tier or equivalent).
mints.remaining: Remaining mints this calendar month: {rem} (tier limit {limit}).

tools.lead: Choose a task on this page. Attesting an existing passport (P / M) stays above; minting opens in the section below.

v03Ops.cardTitle: Passport in the registry — status and actions
v03Ops.lead: Type the passport number (ODP-…) and tap “Load from registry.” You will see what is stored publicly and, if this wallet is allowed, buttons to transfer ownership, update file links, revoke the passport, and similar actions. The “Your passports” list below only includes passports you minted with this wallet — if someone transferred a passport to you, it will not be in that list; enter its number here instead.
v03Ops.creator: Creator (issuer wallet)
v03Ops.revokedYes: Yes — do not treat as valid.
v03Ops.delegation: Trusted helper who can update links (issuer side)
v03Ops.publishAgentHint: One wallet may update the main JSON link and main image link for all passports you created. Set or remove it from the issuer wallet; it is not per passport.
v03Ops.agentUrlLead: Load the passport above first. As the active helper you may change only the main JSON link and main image link (extra images in the record stay as they are). Fingerprints of the passport data cannot be changed here.
v03Ops.agentUrlSubmit: Save new links to the registry
v03Ops.agentUrlUrlTooLong: Each link must be at most 512 characters.
v03Ops.revokeReason: Reason (a short code derived from your text is stored publicly)
v03Ops.cfReason: Short note (stored as a code, not full text)
v03Ops.pAffLead: Parent must be a P-type profile. To propose or confirm a link, use Profile.
v03Ops.pAffProfileLink: Open Profile to propose or confirm →
v03Ops.pAffLeadOnProfile: Here you only unlink a child P profile. To propose or confirm a link, use “Institution structure” above on this page.
v03Ops.notV03: This registry uses older rules — these actions are not available.

pmProof.calloutBody: Someone asked you to confirm something about a passport that already exists in the public registry. You attach your institution’s confirmation to that passport number only — you are not creating a new passport here.
pmProof.body: When you have the passport number (ODP-…), you can record your expert or museum confirmation in the registry. Optional: fingerprint of a PDF (or other file) and a public link. You pay a small network fee; your profile ID is stored as who confirmed.
pmProof.mintFootnote: To create new passports, open “Mint or update passports” below. P and M types are not limited like C/B for monthly counts.
pmProof.humanIdHint: The passport must already exist in the registry. If the number is wrong or missing, your wallet will show an error.
pmProof.noteFileHelp: Upload a certificate, report, or scan — we build a fingerprint in your browser; only the fingerprint is saved publicly.
pmProof.noteFileDrop2: Processed on your device — file is not uploaded to this site
pmProof.noteUrlHint: Use together with a file above: the registry stores link and fingerprint together.
pmProof.listEmpty: No confirmations recorded for your profile yet.
pmProof.needHumanId: Enter a valid passport number (starts with ODP-).
pmProof.urlNeedsHash: To add a link, upload a file first so a fingerprint exists (the registry requires both together).

form.physicalDesc: Artwork, photography, documents, collectibles — any physical object with a seal
form.extraMetaHint: Add rows with a name and a value (inventory number, show, internal reference, …). Empty names are ignored. Whatever you fill in is part of the public passport fingerprint.
form.additionalAccordionLead: Open this section for optional extras: your own named fields, size, weight, dates, and notes. Anything you fill in becomes part of the public passport fingerprint.
form.skipPublicUrl: No public file link — create the passport without a web address for the file. The public Verify page then cannot download your passport from the internet; checks need your local .odpass file. You can add a link later under “Update hosting links.”
form.useFolder: Use a folder on my site — after mint, the app registers a path like …/YourPassportID.odpass automatically (one extra confirm in the wallet)
form.folderHint: No filename — just the folder. After you create the passport, upload your .odpass file named ODP-YYYY-MM-NNNNNNNNN.odpass (your real passport number from the success screen, same spelling). The registry will store your-folder/ODP-….odpass.
form.fullUrlHint: Exact public HTTPS URL of the file after you upload it. Use this if you already know the full path (without using the folder option above).
form.hostingInfoTitleFull: How third-party passport file hosting works
form.digitalWarn: ⚠ Register BEFORE sharing the original. Publish only compressed or watermarked versions after.
form.fdropFileLine1: Drop original file or click to select
form.fdropFileLine2: Fingerprint computed on your device — never uploaded
form.fdropImgLine1: Drop image or click to select
form.c2paHint: Only if you use content-credentials software and it gave you a fingerprint for this file.
form.extraImagesHint: Optional extra pictures. Add the main preview above first; each one gets its own fingerprint in the registry.
form.auxHint: Optional second fingerprint — for example a PDF certificate. Leave empty to skip. If you set a fingerprint, you can add a public https link (up to 512 characters).
form.v03MetaHint: All optional. Anything you enter becomes part of the public passport fingerprint.
form.phListingPrice: e.g. 1200 USD — not a legal offer
form.sealLead: A seal binds this passport to the specific physical object. At least one method required.
form.nfcLead: Protocol + contract: NTAG424DNA_TT (NXP NTAG 424 DNA TagTamper) only. Non–TagTamper chips cannot be minted.
form.feeLine: This registry (version {gen}): you only pay the Polygon network fee (POL) — no extra service fee from us. Often about US$0.01 (varies).
form.preModalTitle: Your passport file — confirm before minting
form.preWithUrlP1: The public registry stores only a fingerprint of your passport — not the full file. You must keep the correct passport.json and publish it at the link you register. If the file is missing or was edited, checks will fail.
form.preWithUrlP2: After creating the passport you get a .odpass package. Upload that whole file unchanged to your HTTPS folder so the link points to it — e.g. …/YourPassportID.odpass. Verify opens passport.json from inside the ZIP in your browser. You can change the link later (small network fee only) under Update hosting links.
form.preSkipUrlP1: You are creating the passport without a public link to the file. The Verify page will not be able to download your passport from the web until you add a link later.
form.preSkipUrlP2: Only someone who has your .odpass file can check details and authenticity against the registry. Keep the file safe and share it on purpose.
form.preAckWithUrl: I understand: I keep the .odpass file and put it at the registered link if I want strangers to verify over the web. Without the file at that address, others cannot verify online.
form.preAckSkipUrl: I understand: without a public file link, Verify cannot load my passport from the web; only people with my .odpass file can check it against the registry.
form.preAckErr: Check the box to confirm you understand, then continue.
form.hostingModalP1: If you use folder hosting in the form, the app registers your-folder/YourPassportID.odpass for you after mint. Otherwise, paste the full .odpass file URL yourself.
form.hostingModalP2: Verify opens your link in the browser. The answer must be the raw passport file or a .odpass ZIP — not a normal web page, not a login screen, not GitHub’s pretty file page.
form.hostingModalP3: Use HTTPS. The link should open the file directly (browser download or raw file), not a menu page.
form.hostingModalP4: On GitHub: use the “Raw” link (raw.githubusercontent.com…), not the project page. Wait until Raw shows your file.
form.hostingModalP5: On your site or cloud storage: upload the whole .odpass file unchanged. The link path must match where the file really is.
form.hostingModalP6: Some private servers block other sites from loading files; public static hosting usually works. If Verify says it cannot load the file, ask your host about “CORS” or try another host.
form.hostingModalP7: Any edit to the file changes its fingerprint. Upload exactly the .odpass you downloaded when you created the passport.
form.hostingModalP8: You may host plain passport.json instead of .odpass; Verify accepts both. If you use .odpass, the link should end with .odpass.
form.urlModalLead: Change where your .odpass (or plain passport.json) and the optional image are hosted. Only the creator wallet can submit. The passport fingerprint in the registry stays the same — the file at the new address must still be the same content. You only pay a small Polygon network fee (POL).
form.urlDataUrlLabel: Passport file URL — .odpass or raw JSON (optional — leave empty to clear public URL)
form.urlSubmit: Save to registry — network fee only (POL)
form.validateFolderUrl: Enter a valid HTTPS folder URL (e.g. https://art.com/passport)
form.validateJsonUrl: Passport file URL (.odpass or raw JSON) is required
form.validateDigitalFile: Original file is required for digital objects
form.validateNfc: NFC chip UID and public key are required
form.validateSeal: Seal number and type are required
form.validateC2pa: The manifest fingerprint must look like a long hex code from your tool (often shown as sha256:… or starting with 0x).
form.validateExtraImagesFirst: Add the main preview image above before extra images.
form.validateAuxUriLen: That link is too long (512 characters max).
form.validateAuxNeedHash: Either add a fingerprint for the extra file or clear the link field.
form.validateAuxHash: The extra fingerprint must be 0x followed by 64 hex characters.
form.mintConfirmWallet: Please confirm the transaction in your wallet
form.mintRegisteringUrl: Saving file link to the registry…
form.mintUrlFail: Mint succeeded, but updating the public file URL failed. Use URLs next to this passport in the list below and set the .odpass (or raw JSON) URL to:
form.mintReadHumanId: Could not read Passport ID from mint receipt.
form.successUploadWithUrl: Upload your .odpass file unchanged to this exact HTTPS link (same file as you downloaded here so the fingerprint matches the registry). Verify reads passport.json from inside the ZIP in your browser:
form.successNoPublicUrl: No public file link is saved in the registry yet. Share the downloaded .odpass only with people who must check it. You can add a link later under Update hosting links.
form.successStep2: Tap Share next to Download for a QR code and a short verify link (odp://… with your passport number).
form.successStep3: Make sure your profile ID {creatorId} is published on your website and social profiles.
form.successIphoneHint: iPhone / MetaMask in-app browser: a plain download may not appear in Files. After downloading .odpass, use the browser or Files app share menu (Save to Files / iCloud), then upload the file to your host unchanged.
form.successDidHint: Optional extra identity file (DID) — you can build it anytime from registry data, including for older passports.
form.odpassModalBody: You can download your .odpass bundle from this page only during this visit. This site does not store it on a server — after you leave, you cannot retrieve this file here again.
form.odpassModal321: Back it up using a 3-2-1 rule: keep at least three copies, on two different types of storage, with one copy off-site (another location or a cloud provider you trust).
form.leaveSuccessConfirm: Leave this screen? Make sure your .odpass file is saved in a safe place. Continue?
form.qrFail: QR library did not load (network / CDN blocked).

urlEdit.urlTooLong: Each URL must be at most 512 characters

errors.connectInProgress: Connection already in progress. Approve or reject the request in your wallet extension, then try again.
errors.walletPending: A wallet request is already open. Use the wallet extension icon in the toolbar to approve or cancel — do not click Connect again until that finishes.

noWallet.line1: No wallet in this browser. On a computer, install
noWallet.mmHint: iPhone / Safari: there is no extension — MetaMask runs as an app with a built-in browser. This link opens the same page there so Connect works.
noWallet.fileProto: Local file URLs — many wallets do not work. Run a simple web server for the web folder or use HTTPS.
noWallet.httpsHint: Use https:// or http://localhost if needed.
